name: Lakshmanagupta
summary: Bridge-teacher: son and pupil of Utpaladeva, initiator of Abhinavagupta into Pratyabhijna and Krama (Abhinava's Krama experiments, incl. the 990 Kramastotra, run on this instruction). No independent works catalogued — his transmission lives in his pupil's corpus.
bio: Son and pupil of Utpaladeva; initiator of Abhinavagupta into Pratyabhijna and Krama (Jayaratha, TA comm.). No independent works catalogued — his transmission lives in his pupil's corpus.
